rows.label: Howl of the Kubrow
rows.note: unlocks the Incubator; no upgrade segment needed

conditions: A Charger permanently occupies one Companion slot.

groups.activity: infect a Warframe with the Helminth Cyst
groups.meta: 24h to appear, 6 more days to mature

rows.label: matured Helminth Cyst
rows.note: Nidus or Nidus Prime: sit in the Helminth chair once
rows.alt: or get infected by another player's Warframe in a mission, dojo or Orbiter

conditions: Start this first: a pink cyst shows on the neck 24 hours after infection and is full size 6 days after that, shown by a tendril.
A second sit in the chair cures the cyst, and a cured Warframe can't be infected again. Cured cysts can't make a Charger.
bonuses: More than one Warframe can carry a cyst, and draining one doesn't cure it, so the same frame makes more Chargers later.

conditions: Equip the infected Warframe, choose Begin Incubation, then press Drain.
Incubation is 48 hours, or 24 with the Nutrio Incubator Upgrade Segment.
A built Power Core is a reusable 50,000-credit Market blueprint, 100,000 credits and 8 hours a build.
bonuses: It is the only companion that uses the Strain mod set. Its Helminth Claws level but give no Mastery.
